subject: Quick question: go / no-go on pilot with Atlas Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@atlashealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + suggested pilot next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Atlas wants safer, lower-latency clinical note summarization embedded into the provider workflow; key success metrics are 30% reduction in average note completion time and <150ms median token latency at peak shifts.

What I heard as priorities:
- Fast turnaround on a small pilot focused on a single specialty (Cardiology)
- Clear privacy controls (VPC + audit logs)
- Rough cost / run-rate estimates up front so procurement can plan

Proposed next step: a 6-week pilot with a dedicated endpoint for one team, weekly checkpoints, and a short ROI checklist at the end. If that sounds reasonable I can:
1) Share a compact mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones
2) Schedule a 30-minute technical sync with your infra/IT to confirm networking and data flow
3) Share a concise cost/ROI one-pager for your procurement team

Attachments: [redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel)]

Can you confirm whether this pilot approach maps to what you expected? If so, are you available for the technical sync next week (options: Wed 2/17 or Thu 2/18, 30 min)?

If this is not a priority right now, a one-line "not a fit / not now" would help us prioritize follow-ups.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Quick nudge on Atlas pilot proposal (short)

Hi Alex —

Just following up on the recap I sent last week. Would love a quick confirmation on whether the 6-week pilot approach is worth pursuing on your side.

Attachments (re-sent): [redwood-demo-deck.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx] — the MAP is intentionally compact (2–3 milestones) so it’s easy to share with procurement.

If now isn’t the right time, no problem — a quick note on timing (e.g., "queue for Q3") or a short "no-go" helps me avoid unnecessary nudges.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@atlashealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@atlashealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick nudge on Atlas pilot proposal (short)

Hi Jordan —

Apologies for the slow reply. We’ve hit an internal budget freeze this quarter and leadership is asking us to defer new pilots unless they are zero-cost this quarter. That said, the use case you outlined still seems promising — it’s just a timing issue.

Short request: could you send a one-paragraph summary of the expected top-line impact and an order-of-magnitude cost estimate for a 6-week pilot (ballpark dollars and monthly operational run-rate)? That will help me advocate for the project to finance and indicate whether there’s any way to accelerate.

For now, please keep us on your radar; I expect we’ll revisit in early Q3.

Best,
Alex Mercer
VP Product, Atlas Health
alex.mercer@atlashealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@atlashealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick nudge on Atlas pilot proposal (one-paragraph ROI + options)

Alex —

Totally understand the budget freeze — appreciate the candid update. Below is the one-paragraph summary you can share with finance; I’ve also attached a one-page ROI snapshot and a trimmed MAP with optional zero-cost scoping notes.

One-paragraph impact & cost (copy/paste friendly):
Redwood’s pilot for Atlas (6 weeks, Cardiology cohort) aims to reduce average provider note completion time by ~30%% via stripped-down, securely hosted summarization APIs. Expected direct operational savings are driven by reduced clinician time per note and faster throughput at peak shifts; for a 20-provider cohort that equates to an estimated $18k–$30k in labor savings over the pilot window, with a comparable monthly run-rate of $2k–$5k depending on usage. Implementation effort is low (we provide a dedicated endpoint, VPC peering, and an onboarding checklist); we can scope a zero-cost technical discovery to validate infra without incurring pilot usage charges.

Attachments: [roic-summary-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

If you’d like, Monica (cc’d) can draft a short slide (2–3 bullets + numbers) you can use with finance, and I can tentatively propose a follow-up for early April to revisit timing. Would you prefer a single slide to share, or should we aim for a short 15-minute finance-ready briefing?

If the answer is "let’s park until Q3," a one-line confirmation is perfect — otherwise we can aim to put something on the calendar.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment stubs included above]
